marks.gloss_en: blemishes should disqualify Levites too, a fortiori from priests
'zot asher la-leviim' -- THIS (the passage of years) pertains to the Levites, and no other disqualification pertains to the Levites
ודין הוא: ומה כהנים שאין השנים פוסלין בהן מומין פוסלין בהן, לוים שהשנים פוסלין בהם אינו דין שיהו מומין פוסלין בהם
תלמוד לומר זאת אשר ללוים -- זאת ללוים ואין אחרת ללוים
מנא הני מילי? דתנו רבנן ... ומבן חמשים שנה ישוב -- years disqualify Levites (kind svara: no plain דתנו רבנן citation kind)
מנא הני מילי? דתנו רבנן: זאת ללוים ואין אחרת ללוים -- blemishes do not disqualify Levites
since it is stated 'and from fifty years old he shall return' (Num 8:25), we learned that years disqualify Levites
the passage of years should disqualify priests too, a fortiori from Levites
'asher la-leviim' -- and not 'asher la-kohanim': the age disqualification is the Levites', not the priests'
והלא דין הוא: ומה לוים שאין מומין פוסלין בהם שנים פוסלין בהם, כהנים שהמומין פוסלין בהם אינו דין שיהו שנים פוסלין בהם
תלמוד לומר אשר ללוים -- ולא אשר לכהנים
מנא הני מילי? ... אשר ללוים ולא אשר לכהנים -- years do not disqualify priests
'which pertains to the Levites' -- and not which pertains to the priests
there is an element with which priests remain fit and Levites are unfit
priests are disqualified by blemishes
the age disqualification of Levites applies only while the service is carrying on the shoulder (the wilderness Tabernacle), not in Shiloh or the eternal Temple
יכול אף בשילה ובבית עולמים כן? תלמוד לומר לעבד עבדת עבודה ועבדת משא
one verse states 'from twenty-five years old and upward' (Num 8:24) -- prima facie, Levite service starts at twenty-five
a student who saw no positive sign in his studies in five years will not see one
מכאן -- from the five years between learning (25) and service (30)
שנאמר ולגדלם שנים שלש ... וללמדם ספר ולשון כשדים
the language of the Chaldeans is different -- it is easy (so Daniel's three years prove nothing about Torah study)
ואידך -- שאני הלכות עבודה דתקיפין: for R' Yosei the Levites' five years prove nothing, the laws of service being hard (= p_shani_hilchot_avoda)
ואידך -- שאני לשון כשדים דקליל: for the tanna kamma Daniel's three years prove nothing, the Chaldean language being easy (= p_shani_leshon_kasdim)
a priest is fit for service from two pubic hairs until he ages, and blemishes disqualify him
'זאת' -- THIS heifer is killed by breaking the neck, and no other
the Merciful One excluded with regard to the broken-necked heifer: 'זאת' -- this one by breaking the neck, and no other by breaking the neck
the broken-necked heifer should be fit by slaughter too
'וערפו העגלה' -- by breaking the neck yes, by slaughter no
if the red heifer, which is not made fit by breaking the neck, is fit by slaughter, the broken-necked heifer, which is fit by breaking the neck, should surely be made fit by slaughter
אמר קרא 'וערפו העגלה' -- by breaking the neck yes, by slaughter no
verbal designation should render the goat a sin offering, a fortiori from the case where the lottery does not sanctify
'ועשהו חטאת' -- the lottery renders it a sin offering, a verbal designation does not
where the lot does not sanctify, the name sanctifies; where the lot sanctifies, should not the name surely sanctify?
ת"ל 'ועשהו חטאת' -- the lot makes it a sin offering, and the name does not
'and he shall make it a sin offering' -- the lot makes it a sin offering
the reason is that the Merciful One wrote 'and he shall make it a sin offering'; otherwise, we would expound a kal vachomer [although חוקה is written there]
